scope: Guarded offline ODAC23 S2EF active-learning feasibility runs

skills.trigger: Before an acquisition selector reads a candidate extended-XYZ file.
skills.check: Candidate structures contain no reference energy, force, or calculator-result fields.
skills.action: Stop the run, regenerate the blind candidate file, and record the failed attempt if any label field is present.

skills.check: The model, optimizer inputs, and structure tensors share the checkpoint dtype.
skills.action: Use float64 consistently for the verified MPA-0 checkpoint; do not silently cast selected tensors.

skills.trigger: Launching MACE training from an orchestrated run directory.
skills.check: Model, checkpoint, log, and results directories exist before the CLI starts.
skills.action: Create the scoped directories and validate the expected model path after training.

skills.trigger: Evaluating a fine-tuned foundation model on group-disjoint MOFs.
skills.check: Every atomic number in validation and final-holdout structures is represented by the model element table.
skills.action: Retain the complete foundation element table when a heldout element is absent from acquired labels; otherwise fail before scoring.

skills.trigger: Promoting a candidate MLIP after S2EF evaluation.
skills.check: Energy-per-atom and force-component errors both satisfy their predeclared non-regression thresholds on an untouched evaluation partition.
skills.action: Reject the candidate when either target fails. A force-only gain cannot override energy-calibration failure.
